title: PF0 measurable success outcomes
measurement_rule: A measure is satisfied only by evidence bound to the reviewed candidate and declared scope. Planning completion, cross-language agreement and compiled application artifacts are not substitutes for engineering or installed-product evidence.

measures.desired_outcome: The first product and later automation serve named engineering work.
measures.measure: Trace every accepted capability and public operation to at least one user workflow and scenario.
measures.target: 100% traceability; zero orphan capabilities or operations in the PF11 baseline.

measures.desired_outcome: Every implemented engineering operation has an appropriate source and independent assurance route.
measures.measure: Count accepted engineering operations with source provenance, applicability, worked examples, boundary evidence and an independent assurance classification.
measures.target: 100% of the maintained common engineering set before implementation acceptance.

measures.desired_outcome: A whole-member result cannot appear complete when a required check is absent or unevaluated.
measures.measure: Inject an omitted, inapplicable and unevaluated required check into member-result conformance cases and inspect aggregate outcome and issue eligibility.
measures.target: 100% of such cases remain visibly incomplete and cannot support a current issued package.

measures.desired_outcome: Every public operation is understandable, explicit and linked to examples.
measures.measure: Audit purpose, applicability, fields, units, signs, conditionality, optional resolution, outputs, diagnostics, provenance, compatibility and positive/non-success examples.
measures.target: 100% of public operations satisfy the PF5 signature rubric before inclusion.

measures.desired_outcome: Python and .NET engineering services work as ordinary libraries outside Excel and ETABS.
measures.measure: Install and execute small-calculation and whole-member example journeys in each pure library environment.
measures.target: Both journeys run in both languages with zero Excel, CSI, COM, workbook or UI dependency.

measures.desired_outcome: The deliberately maintained Python/.NET common set has the same engineering meaning.
measures.measure: Replay valid, invalid, boundary and unsupported conformance vectors and compare effective inputs, discrete states and quantities using the declared tolerances.
measures.target: 100% of common-set vectors agree semantically; zero pass/fail or applicability disagreements.

measures.desired_outcome: A reviewer can reproduce the basis of an engineering result.
measures.measure: Inspect rich result records for effective inputs, code-data identity, applicability, rule/example provenance, engine identity, diagnostics and result freshness where applicable.
measures.target: 100% of member/check result schemas carry the required evidence fields and reproduce from the same normalized inputs.

measures.desired_outcome: An engineer can complete a standalone beam journey in Windows Excel and understand missing information and governing results.
measures.measure: Run the reference workbook from project/input entry through checks, resolved reinforcement, report and save/reopen on the supported installed configuration.
measures.target: All reference journey steps pass; invalid cells identify field/member location; reopened results retain identity and freshness.

measures.desired_outcome: Imported and reanalysed forces remain bound to the correct model, analysis state, action basis, station and axes.
measures.measure: Exercise read-only acquisition, fixed-demand search and one stiffness-changing candidate transaction on an identified model copy.
measures.target: Every accepted result retains complete source identity; a model-changing candidate cannot reuse the prior analysis snapshot.

measures.desired_outcome: BBS, bar lengths, quantities, prices and formwork measurements derive from resolved buildable details.
measures.measure: Reconcile every output item to member/detail identity, bar paths or explicit concrete/formwork geometry and declared pricing/measurement policy.
measures.target: 100% item traceability and zero silent substitution of required steel area for scheduled steel.

measures.desired_outcome: Performance is measured at the boundary users experience.
measures.measure: Define and run candidate-bound benchmarks for scalar kernel, member batch, candidate search, serialization, workbook recalculation and ETABS acquisition.
measures.target: PF9 sets a numeric budget and reference environment for all six classes; accepted implementation meets every applicable budget.

measures.desired_outcome: Engineering meaning has one owner and dependency direction remains enforceable.
measures.measure: Check capability ownership, package dependency direction, generated/handwritten artifact ownership and consumer drift.
measures.target: 100% capability ownership; zero forbidden upward or host dependencies in pure packages; zero unexplained schema drift.

measures.desired_outcome: Existing useful callers can adopt corrected semantics without silently preserving ambiguity.
measures.measure: Assign retain, correct, compatibility-wrap, replace or omit disposition to each existing public/de facto operation and document affected callers.
measures.target: 100% disposition coverage and a migration example for every retained breaking semantic correction.

measures.desired_outcome: Library, compiled XLL and installed-product claims are based on the evidence each claim requires.
measures.measure: Bind package, XLL, workbook, installed Excel/ETABS and benchmark evidence to the exact candidate and stated environment.
measures.target: 100% release claims have matching candidate-bound evidence and required authorization; zero evidence-category substitutions.
